title: Bathroom
content: I'm going to make a long story short. I saw one of the many bathrooms that I constantly see in my dreams in real life and I took a picture. Let me know if anyone has ever seen a bathroom like this or similar in their dreams because when I saw it in real life my heart dropped and my heart started racing, I went into fight or flight mode and I almost ran out of the bathroom. The picture does not give it justice on how huge it actually was. For my own safety I'm not going to mention the state but this was in a Staples store. Just looking at the picture now still gives me the creeps and I need to know I'm not the only one that has seen something like this in my dreams. Except they usually don't have a door for some reason.
